## What changed

Describe the reports, templates or process guidance added.

## Why

Explain how the change improves reproducibility, triage or retesting.

## Quality check

- [ ] Titles are concise and searchable
- [ ] Steps reproduce the behaviour from a known state
- [ ] Expected and actual results are observable
- [ ] Severity and priority have separate reasoning
- [ ] Evidence contains no sensitive information
- [ ] Retest criteria cover boundaries and nearby regressions
- [ ] Examples do not make unsupported claims about third-party products
